rationale: The Evaluator feedback confirms that the last candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to verify the effects of the current parameters. The current controller settings reduce base_speed slightly to 1.35 to lower aggressive driving, increase kd to 4.0 for stronger damping, and keep kp at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights are set to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], preserving steering balance and increasing inner sensor influence for better precision. The geometry remains unchanged as no issues were reported. These changes aim to reduce oscillations and line loss events while maintaining good progress. I expect improved stability and smoother line following. I request telemetry on completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to confirm these improvements.
